items.title: HUD condition polarity pills and +N overflow popover
items.do: On Aveline, apply at least 4 active conditions/effects (mix buffs like Empowered / Shield of Faith and debuffs like Prone, Daunted, Hindered), then select Aveline's token and click the +N button on the HUD conditions row.
items.expect: Debuffs (including Daunted) and buffs render cleanly with full top and bottom borders (no clipped outline), and past 3 items a +N ▾ button opens a popover grouped into Debuffs, Buffs, and Other.

items.title: Chat card Down chip and single-row footer with Card button
items.do: With Aveline (Longsword), apply damage to an Orc Warrior that puts it Down (both Bloodied and Strained, or total damage at/past its Health Pool), and also apply damage to an Orc Warrior with Resist Slash 2.
items.expect: A Down creature shows a single "Down" badge instead of "Bloodied Strained". The post-Apply Resist tag stays compact ("Slash −2" with shield icon) on the same line as "Took", and the "Card" button stays on the right of the footer instead of wrapping underneath.
